source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Reciprocal verbs in Sakha and the lexicon/syntax dichotomy
notes: Under causativization lexical reciprocals follow the intransitive case pattern: the causee can only be in the accusative. Syntactic reciprocals follow the transitive case pattern and allow a dative causee in addition to the accusative one.
en: I made Misha and Masha see/meet each other.
